AI-Mini-Drama-P1-01.title: Video generation always fails: server storage upload times out
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-01.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Video generation always fails after ~6 min as the storage upload times out
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-01.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama and create a drama through the storyboard
3. On Choose your video settings pick Seedance 2.0, Preview - 30 sec, tap Generate
4. Wait about 6 minutes
5. Check the result

Result:
Every video attempt (5/5, 4 dramas) fails after ~6 min; the log shows the storage upload timing out.
摘要：影片生成 5 次皆在約 6 分鐘後失敗，log 顯示上傳參考圖到 storage 逾時。
{16.9.0_amd37_fix_clips_ending.jpg} {16.9.0_amd37_try_again_ending.jpg} {16.9.0_amd37_no_card_ending.jpg} {16.9.0_amd37_log.txt}

Expect Result:
The preview video is generated and shown with Here's your drama.
摘要：應成功生成預覽影片並顯示 Here's your drama.。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Main flow board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2
Related: DRI261896P0020 (same symptom on 189631, closed Not Reproducible); reproduced 7/7 on 189729 with the cause in the attached log
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-01.qa_note: Every video attempt in the run failed, on four dramas: Echoes in the Dark 10/19 19:47 (preview) and 19:59 (clip regenerate ◆60), Shared Solitude 20:18, Across Distance 21:13, Sweet Rivalry 10/20 10:06 (fresh install) — plus the two storyboard-image revisions on Shared Turf at 17:16 and 17:24 (TC-073). Each ends after ~361 s with the same log line: workflow step failed step=prompt_1 skill=video-generation-batch error="HTTP PUT to storage URL failed: Failed to read connection (url=https://storage.googleapis.com/cl-aol-media-demo/source/Chat/…/input.N.png…)" — the reference-image upload before filming times out. The UI then shows one of three endings: 「1 clip couldn't be generated.」 + 「Fix Clips」 (Echoes), 「Something went wrong on my end.」 + 「Try again」 (Shared Solitude), or nothing at all with the video settings card removed (Across Distance). No video credits were ever charged (authorisations revoked). DRI261896P0020 (same symptom, build 189631, 1/1, no cause) was closed as NotReproducible; this run reproduces it 7/7 on 189729 across 4 dramas and a fresh install, with the server-side cause, which is the new ground for raising it again (the user asked on 2026-10-20 to file it). Cite DRI261896P0020 in the ticket. Blocks TC-085, 087–090, 093, 095–099, 167, 168, 174. S1 because no user can get any video out of the feature on this build/server; downgrade if RD shows it is a Developer Server storage outage.

AI-Mini-Drama-P1-02.title: Storyboard and video Stop cancel silently
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-02.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UX] AI Mini Drama: Storyboard and video Stop cancel silently with no credit message
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-02.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama and create a drama up to the Create storyboard card
3. Tap Generate, then tap Stop while it is generating
4. Repeat on the Choose your video settings card: Generate, then Stop
5. Check the result

Result:
Both stages disappear back to the offer card with no message about what stopped or the credits.
摘要：分鏡與影片生成按 Stop 後直接消失回到報價卡，未說明停止了什麼及點數如何處理。
{16.9.0_amd32_storyboard_running.jpg} {16.9.0_amd32_storyboard_after_stop.jpg} {16.9.0_amd32_video_running.jpg} {16.9.0_amd32_video_after_stop.jpg} {16.9.0_amd32_log.txt}

Expect Result:
Stop says what will stop and whether the credits are refunded, then stops the stage.
摘要：按 Stop 應說明停止的工作及點數是否退還，再停止該階段。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-02.qa_note: Rule 2 (user QA rule, R-138): Stop must say what stops and what happens to spent credits. Storyboard (Across Distance, Create storyboard ◆28, Stop 21:09:13) and video (Seedance 2.0 Preview ◆120, Stop 21:22:38): both vanish instantly back to the offer card with no dialog, toast or chat line. The log shows the authorisation revoked (unused_credit=28 at 21:09:15, unused_credit=120 at 21:22:41), so nothing is charged — the user is just never told. Outline and revision Stop are already DRI261893-0128 (still reproduces, TC-153/155); character generation has no Stop at all (DRI261895P0024). Compare the Back button at the outline stage, which does explain (Leave this chat?).

AI-Mini-Drama-P1-03.title: Character and storyboard generation block far beyond ten seconds
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-03.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent] AI Mini Drama: Character and storyboard generation block the screen for over a minute
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-03.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama and create a drama to the cast step
3. Open Change Characters, tap ✓ with characters unset, tap Generate all
4. Try to close the sheet or go Back while it generates
5. Confirm, then Generate on the Create storyboard card and time the wait
6. Check the result

Result:
Characters lock the screen ~76 s (no Back, ✕ ignored); the storyboard blocks ~2 min with only Stop.
摘要：角色生成鎖住畫面約 76 秒（無法返回、✕ 無效），分鏡生成約 2 分鐘只能按 Stop。
{16.9.0_amd33_characters_locked.jpg} {16.9.0_amd33_close_ignored.jpg} {16.9.0_amd33_storyboard_wait.jpg} {16.9.0_amd33_log.txt}

Expect Result:
No wait with only a leave/Stop option lasts over 10 s; the user can always leave the sheet.
摘要：只能離開或停止的等待不應超過 10 秒，且使用者隨時可離開。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-03.qa_note: Rule 2 (user QA rule, R-140): a wait with nothing to do but leave must stay under 10 s with an animation. Characters (Generate all ◆8, 2 characters): 20:56:02 → 20:57:18, ~76 s; during it the Finish your characters sheet ignores its ✕ and the dimmed page covers Back, so the user cannot even leave (TC-161). Storyboard (◆28): 21:09:44 → 21:11:45, log turn wall 116.3 s. Outline, revision and video already have tickets (DRI261895P0029/P0030/P0031, all still reproduce); this entry covers the two stages without one. Earlier in the run the character load was 70.7 s (log) and storyboards 2–4 min.

AI-Mini-Drama-P1-04.qa_note: Clean fresh install of 189729 (2026-10-20 09:53), first video of the install (Seedance 2.0 Preview ◆120, 10:06:09), Back at 10:06:23 while generating: the landing page shows no blue bubble under the History button, screenshots 0.7 s and 2 s after. Note:

Spec Link: AI Mini Drama PM spec, Main flow board - https://www.figma.com/design/44RyrcOcWi2MvhGci9bO5F/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=2016-2

AI-Mini-Drama-P1-06.title: Credit card turns into a plain option after the chat-limit dialog
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-06.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI Mini Drama: Create storyboard card loses its price after the chat-limit dialog

2. Open a drama whose chat ends with the Create storyboard credit card
3. Use up today's chats, type a message and tap Send

{16.9.0_amd36_card_before.jpg} {16.9.0_amd36_option_after.jpg}

The Create storyboard card keeps its price and Generate button.
摘要：Create storyboard 卡片應保留價格與 Generate 按鈕。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Storyboard board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-06.qa_note: Off-case observation O-23 (Crime Romance). With the daily chats used up (Pink Unlimited daily chat OFF + Use up today's chats), sending a message shows the limit dialog; after closing it with ✕ the 「Create storyboard ◆31 · Generate」 credit card is re-rendered as a plain 「Create storyboard →」 option row with no price (21:54 on 10/19 and 08:49 on 10/20). 4. Open the failed scene

{16.9.0_amd38_card.jpg} {16.9.0_amd38_info_dialog.jpg} {16.9.0_amd38_log.txt}

Spec string: 「Your credits have been refunded. The service is busy - try again later.」

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
Spec Link: AI Mini Drama Design spec, Storyboard board - https://www.figma.com/design/dZk5HLzZTdcZwWwvN9aZfZ/AI-Mini-Drama?node-id=116-7873
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-07.qa_note: Scene image failure injected with Pink › Fail media tool = TextToImage (tool_error → the app's 4xx path), Echoes in the Dark Scene 3. Card: 「Couldn't create image ⓘ」 / 「Your credits have been refunded. Try editing the description for a different result.」 with Edit. Design ds-storyboard (1012 frames) shows the card as 「Couldn't create image ⓘ」 / 「Your credits have been refunded. The service is busy - try again later.」; PM's newer error board uses the app's wording. The ⓘ dialog matches Design's 4xx frame exactly. The 10/16 run withdrew the opposite finding (ISS-AMD-16) under the Design-first rule, so this needs a PM/Design ruling on which card copy is right: Design's 「service is busy」 contradicts its own terms-of-service dialog. Owner PM.

AI-Mini-Drama-P1-08.title: Leaving during outline generation discards the drama
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-08.short: PDR-I 16.9.0 - [AIAgent][UX] AI Mini Drama: Leaving during outline generation discards the drama instead of keeping it
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-08.desc:
Repro Steps:
1. Launch the APP
2. Open AI Mini Drama, enter an idea and tap Generate on the format card
3. While the outline is generating tap Back, then Leave anyway
4. Return to AI Mini Drama and open History
5. Check the result

Result:
The drama is gone from History; the outline that was generating cannot be continued.
摘要：離開後該劇本消失，History 無紀錄，無法繼續。
{16.9.0_amd39_leave_dialog.jpg} {16.9.0_amd39_history_without_it.jpg} {16.9.0_amd39_log.txt}

Expect Result:
The outline keeps generating and the drama appears in History, like later stages.
摘要：大綱應繼續生成並出現在 History，與其他階段一致。

Note:
Device: iPhone 17 Air / iOS 26.2.1
<Claude Reviewed>
AI-Mini-Drama-P1-08.qa_note: Spec (TC-025 dialog) says leaving before the outline exists loses the chat, and the app warns: 「Leave this chat?」 / 「Your story outline isn't ready yet, so this chat won't be saved.」. The user's QA rule 2 (R-139) expects any running stage to survive leaving as a recognizable task. The log shows the outline actually finished at 20:51:35 (turn complete, stage outline), a few seconds before Leave anyway was tapped while the dialog still said the outline was not ready, and the drama was discarded anyway. Every later stage does survive (characters, revision, storyboard and video all keep running in the background and reopen from History); only the outline is thrown away, even though it finishes in ~30 s. Owner PM: decide whether the outline should also continue in the background.
